desc: APPROVED-PLAN HISTORY; NON-RUNNABLE UMBRELLA. The original one-shot combined HPM source policy, VBUS, repeater, ATC, DART/xHCI, and enumeration—too many unproved boundaries. Completed inputs: 093 inactive selector, 094 WAKEUP/state 0x07, 095 SSPS/S0 0x00. Rig recovery now passes, but 096 is a final R3 no-go and there is no safe forward/inverse artifact. Decomposed children remain blocked pending new primary rollback evidence. Preserve the passive bus-powered stick fixture and all original prohibitions. Historical plan approval does not approve new child artifacts. RISK CALIBRATION 2026-07-25: the earlier framing implying an unrecoverable/permanently-damaged port is WITHDRAWN. No persistent-brick mechanism exists in the staged op set (no flash/OTP/patch-bundle writes; runtime register RMW + 4CC only), SN201202x state is volatile and re-initialized by AppleHPM each boot, and the right port holds only the passive stick (M1 cable is on the DFU port). Worst realistic case is odd port state until a power cycle, which is free in a workflow that power-cycles every chainload. The ticket-096 sequence decode remains incomplete, which is a separate completeness question tracked in 096 and not a danger statement. See evidence/2026-07-25-t6040-r3-risk-calibration.md.
